source_text: Quarta prophetia. Balac iratus plaudit manibus: maledicere vocavi te et benedixisti. Fuge in locum tuum.
pass_a_gloss: Fourth prophecy. Balak angry claps with-hands: to-curse I-called you and you-blessed. Flee into place your.
pass_b_english: [[Fourth prophecy >> Bible:Numbers 24:10-19]]. Balak strikes his hands in anger: I called you to curse, and you have blessed; flee to your place.
